baseline.description: Exact V2 comparison baseline: nominal mass/friction, cube initial XY +/-0.04m, fixed target offset (0,+0.06)m

mass_random.description: Cube mass and inertia scaled together, 0.6..1.4x

friction_random.description: All cube/table/finger-pad contact friction coefficients scaled 0.5..1.5x

object_position_wide.description: Cube XY uniform +/-0.06m instead of +/-0.04m; target remains cube+(0,+0.06)m

target_position_random.description: Target position independently jittered +/-0.02m per axis relative to cube+(0,+0.06)m

combined_hard.description: All factors varied strongly (OOD stress test, not training distribution)
